mainEntity.name: What outdoor kitchen features are actually worth paying for?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best features are the ones you will use regularly. For many homeowners, a high-quality grill, durable countertops, storage, and task lighting are more valuable than decorative extras. Sinks, refrigerators, and warming drawers can be useful if you cook outdoors often, but they also increase cost and complexity. In a climate like Los Angeles County, durable materials and weather-resistant finishes usually matter more than oversized accessories. Focus on convenience, cleanup, and durability before adding luxury items. A smart design balances function and budget instead of loading the space with features that rarely get used.
